about: Release candidate, item 2 (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.9): every automatable item of trap15-a section 13, hardware section 13 and the sim-ui section 19 quirks marked as affecting program results, with the tests that prove it. Built by hand by I3 from the three specs and the test sources on 2026-11-22; checked by item-02-checklists.mjs (every named program must have an official result, and every named test must exist with exactly the title given; brought up to date on 2026-11-22 with T3's reviewed mapping, errata T3 12 and 13). verdict: proved = the named tests cover the whole item; partial = they cover a part (note says which); none = no test found; manual = needs a person or a device. A program proof counts against the official SIM68K.exe golden; a test proof is a unit, engine or conformance test against what the spec dictates (no golden).
